why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Anichess site Go to the Anichess home page to see the game, its spell list and the current event.
2 Step 2 : Start a free match Choose Play for free on the play page to open a game in your browser.
3 Step 3 : Learn the spell rules Read how a match runs: you gain mana each turn, spend it on spells with limited charges, and win by capturing the king.
4 Step 4 : Try the Halloween Adventure While the event is live, open the Haunted Mansion page to start it.
5 Step 5 : Set up a game with friends Use the invite option to choose your own format and settings, then play a match on your terms.
